column3: Close to the Hebrew; “those who rise against me” is rendered “my enemies.”
Close to the Hebrew; the future “you will repay” is rendered as a plea, “Repay them.”
Close to the Hebrew; “shamelessness of heart” (a rare word) is rendered “a veiled heart,” and the future “you will give” “Give.”
Close to the Hebrew; the futures “you will pursue … destroy” are rendered as pleas, “Pursue and destroy them.”
